prompt:
2D hand-painted fantasy MMORPG game asset, soft painted style similar to classic Ragnarok Online, warm friendly medium-low saturation colors, soft top-left lighting.
Project Mythraven Online. Style Soft Painted Fantasy 2D. Use case identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Animation identity correction, not new poses.
INPUT1 is the SHIPPED SIDE-FACING WEST IDLE IDENTITY MASTER. This is the authoritative exact hair, head, face, palette, tunic, leather, boots, metal and costume shading. It is enlarged 4x from the real game texture; DO NOT invent additional hairstyle volume or change the rendering.
INPUT2 is the EXISTING 8-FRAME WALK EDIT TARGET, 4 columns x2 rows. Preserve its complete action and EXACT anatomical left/right limbs/near-far order, all positions, silhouettes below neck, shoulder/waist twist, leg bends and contacts.
Current issue: walk head is ~41-42px wide vs idle38px at final240px canvas, hair too bulky and its shape/shading different. Walk clothes and boots also differ in brown shades and highlight values. Fix ONLY identity/colors/head size.
Replace every walk head with the EXACT hair/face/head appearance from INPUT1. The head should be ~10% narrower, its exact silhouette, tuft pattern, face proportions, warm brown hue and soft shading matching INPUT1. Align at neck; do not enlarge the body to compensate. Head must remain SAME size across all eight frames. Keep gaze strictly W, not angled toward camera. Every frame must look like the SAME idle person has merely started walking.
Recolor existing walk tunic, ivory trims/rolled sleeves, leather gloves, gold buckles, trousers, steel armor and brown boots to precisely the corresponding materials in INPUT1. Use its shading style/contrast, do not increase saturation or shine. The boots should be the exact same leather color as idle, not orange/red. Preserve existing pixel geometry, accessory sizes and placement, natural shoulder/waist counter-rotation.
CRITICAL unchanged poses:1 nearleftlead/rightback;2 leftsupport/rightrecovercloselybehind;3 far rightkneeup/leftsupport;4 rightlead/leftback;5 rightlead wide;6 rightsupport/leftrecoverback;7 near leftkneeup/rightsupport;8 leftlead/rightback. Do NOT swap the leading leg, alter feet, draw new arms, change arm swing, change spacing or body scale, freeze torso, or straighten bent knees. COLORS AND HEAD IDENTITY ONLY.
Output same 4x2 arrangement, eight whole characters, same generous padding and slot registration as INPUT2. Actual transparent alpha, no floor/shadow, background, captions, lettering, labels, grid marks or watermark. Faint darker outline, no red/green fringes. Final export240x240 cells, feetanchor120,216. Single full-sheet edit for temporal consistency.
note: Whole-sheet edit evaluated alongside exact shipped idle; export locks the head to real idle pixels and material palettes to the shipped idle.
outputDecision: Whole-sheet generated edit was not selected because it did not match the shipped idle head exactly. Retired generated bitmap after inspection.
